admission.justification: Guarding both static surfaces prevents removed APIs appearing alive as SPA pages or unrelated assets.

applicability: Exact /api root or descendants with no non-Mount route match.
exclusions: Known path wrong method; outside /api; other Mount semantics.
OPTIONS is source-backed by method-independent code, not exercised by these cited tests.

evidence: FormerRouteTests; MountedBundleTests; L9 reviewer composed-app and running-sandbox probes.

statement: A request to an unknown /api path returns 404 for every method before either static surface, so the removed host routes have no aliases.
